name: Tuner
tagline: Reads what your other bots have been producing and drafts fixes for the ones drifting
description: A bot that has quietly wandered off its brief keeps working, which is exactly why nobody catches it. This one reads back the recent output of each bot you own, measures it against whatever that bot was originally hired to do, and writes up the wording or routine changes it would make. Nothing ships without your say-so.
author: humanmeteorite
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
